purpose: Internal preparation inventory, not a learner question bank or publication approval

statusDefinitions.pilot_bank: Newly authored questions and per-question provenance exist; tester-only and pending independent review
statusDefinitions.catalog_content_needs_question_audit: Learning content exists, but source-to-question mapping and a reviewed exercise bank do not
statusDefinitions.other_learning_content_needs_question_au: Learning content exists outside the published catalog; source-to-question mapping and a reviewed exercise bank do not
statusDefinitions.content_and_question_audit_needed: No catalog items or identified special learning page for this lesson and skill; curriculum and source exercises need inspection

topicStatusDefinitions.pilot_bank: A tester-only bank exists for this card topic
topicStatusDefinitions.partial_coverage_in_verbs_pilot: Some verb content is exercised in the Verben pilot; the catalog group is not a separate reviewed bank
topicStatusDefinitions.review_only_scope_check: Catalog grouping needs a curriculum scope check before becoming a practice topic
topicStatusDefinitions.needs_item_audit: Group or mapped topic has no individually audited question bank

questionContract.grading: Use acceptedAnswers for closed questions or a reviewed rubric for open writing
questionContract.publicationGate: Every question has an independently reviewed answer and learner copy contains no source attribution
